name: COD Hub
description: Open a COD Hub card to import MW4 builds, explore weapons and attachments, manage saved loadouts, and share cards or PNGs. Includes attributed meta loadouts and dated wiki references.

slash_commands.description: Open COD Hub to import, explore and share builds

options.description: Second weapon name, prefix or MW4 build code

options.name: view
options.description: Overview, reviewed measurements or their sources

slash_commands.description: Decode an MW4 build code and create a shareable card

options.name: game
options.description: Code catalog to use (defaults to MW4)
